sloka: तत्रेषूपयन्त्राणि बलवन्ति महान्ति च ।आगतम् पर सैन्यम् तैस् तत्र प्रतिनिवार्यते ॥६-३-१२॥।।
transliteration: tatreṣūpayantrāṇi balavanti mahānti ca ।āgatam para sainyam tais tatra pratinivāryate ॥6-3-12॥।।

translations.english: "The doors are fitted with powerful machines which retaliate by discharging darts and stones on the enemy's army and kill them."
